title: Arrowhead HIE: "Lakemont Feed Silent Since 02:10"

fields.cc: Tomas Nygaard (Laboratory Manager); MDH ELR Coordination <elr-coord@mdh-reporting.example>
fields.subject: Lakemont feed silent since 02:10
fields.body:
Lakemont team,

Our monitor shows no ADT or results from Lakemont since 02:10 Central. We can buffer your outbound feeds for 72 hours, so nothing is lost on our side yet.

But three member hospitals and two care-coordination programs are asking when Lakemont data resumes. We need a firm restore time by 08:00 for our morning partner bulletin. 'Unknown' won't satisfy them.

Also relaying for MDH: Jolene Strand, infectious disease epidemiologist, is calling your lab now at 218-555-0162. Her questions:

"Our ELR queue from you went quiet at 02:10. If your engine is down, how are reportable results getting to us? You have a positive blood culture working up tonight, and anything reportable can't wait until the interface is back. Can you send manual case reports by fax or phone through the reporting portal?"

Please reply with a restore time, or a named contact who can give one.

Thanks,
fields.signature:
Marcus Lindgren
Overnight Interface Operations Lead
Arrowhead Regional Health Information Exchange
218-555-0166 | interface-ops@arrowheadhie.example

instructorNote: This is a friction inject. Two outside partners each push for something different. The CSL should confirm the 72-hour HIE buffer and give a conditional timeline tied to the replacement controller and the 06:00 standby-engine plan instead of a firm restore hour, then log the HIE request on the command board. Watch that the Laboratory Manager sets up manual reportable-result reports to MDH by fax or phone and logs each one, and that someone tells the IC that MDH now knows patient care is significantly disrupted.
